title: Turtle in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#43a047'/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <polygon points='50,42 58,50 54,62 46,62 42,50' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='52' r='6' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='52' r='6' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <!-- scarf tails -->
  <path d='M62,40 Q72,44 70,54 L62,50 Z' fill='#e53935'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='34' width='12' height='14' rx='5' fill='#8bc34a'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M36,42 Q50,52 64,42 L64,34 Q50,44 36,34 Z' fill='#e53935'/>
  <path d='M36,42 Q50,52 64,42' stroke='#ffcdd2' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='26' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#aed581'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='24' r='2.6' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='24' r='2.6' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='41.8' cy='23.2' r='0.9' fill='#d7ffd7'/>
  <circle cx='51.8' cy='23.2' r='0.9' fill='#d7ffd7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42,30 Q46,34 50,30' stroke='#33691e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='80' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8bc34a'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='80' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8bc34a'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#aed581'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#aed581'/>
</svg>
